On the declared finite metric/curvature toy model the Schur-complement adequacy residual for the FORM-leg probe has normalized ξ_rel -> ~machine-zero stably across both refinements (4.11e-16, 2.84e-15) and across seeds (D0 = A*L0 exactly on the iso sector), so STEP1 of the decision procedure seals E1 = computable descent.
